programmes.d: The queens read each other in the mini challenge, then practice their comedy skills in a roast of Michelle Visage, with guest judges Fortune Feimster and Tamar Braxton.
The queens write, produce and star in their own television pilots, then show off couture club-kid looks, and Noah Galvin and Lisa Robertson guest judge.
The queens transform the Drag Race crew from drab to fab in a makeover challenge, and Kesha and designer Zaldy guest judge.
The queens impersonate each other with puppets, then walk the runway for the Gayest Ball Ever, and Andie MacDowell and Joan Smalls guest judge.
The Top Four queens write song verses for Ru's song 'Category Is' and try their hand at podcasting as guests on Ru's pod, 'What's the Tee?'
The queens come together for a fiery reunion special, where they talk lip-sync fails, social media scandals and a newly crowned Miss Congeniality that sparks debate.
In this Emmy Award-winning series hosted by RuPaul, America's most sickening queens compete in fashion and performance challenges in hopes of snatching the crown as the next drag superstar.
Christina Aguilera stunts on the mainstage, favorite queens from past seasons return, and 14 new queens compete to become America's Next Drag Superstar.
The queens must wow the judges (including Halsey and Padma Lakshmi) in a lip-synced dance number inspired by pharmaceutical TV ads, and Andy Cohen and Alyssa Edwards drop by.
The queens create and star in commercials for new drag-themed dating apps, and rock goddess Courtney Love and actor Nico Tortorella guest judge.
The queens cook up global warming-friendly looks for the last ball ever, and actresses Tisha Campbell-Martin and Logan Browning drop by to guest judge.
The queens' improv skills are put to the test for the new talk show 'Bossy Rossy,' hosted by Ross Matthews, and country music icon Shania Twain and actress Carrie Preston guest judge.
The queens have to produce and host their very own DragCon panels on makeup, hair and body, and Kumail Nanjiani and Emily V. Gordon guest judge.
With Audra McDonald and Kate Upton as guest judges, the queens impersonate celebrities for the legendary Snatch Game, and Bianca Del Rio and Alex Trebek are special guests.
